description.full: Automated deployment bot for APM-02 snapshots, cherry-pick windows, and CI/CD retries.

commands.title: share snapshot
commands.description: Default 60m wait, or specify custom wait time e.g. share snapshot 85m

commands.title: deploy now
commands.description: Bypass waiting countdown and deploy snapshot to APM-02 immediately

commands.title: extend
commands.description: Add minutes to countdown (default: +10m, or specify e.g. extend 15m)

commands.title: reduce
commands.description: Subtract minutes from countdown (default: -10m, or specify e.g. reduce 5m)

commands.title: re-trigger
commands.description: Restart pipeline without code changes (only when APM-02 Failed; idle won't work)

commands.title: deployment fix pushed, re-deploy
commands.description: Re-deploy after pushing fix to snapshot branch (only when APM-02 Failed; idle won't work)

commands.title: status
commands.description: Query real-time APM-02 deployment status & active tracking PR

commands.title: help
commands.description: Display complete command guide and rules
